name: frequency-development-replay-20260924
purpose: Exact original 14-UCI development replay for one unary-frequency ablation. The parent separately supplies cached legacy houses/wine to form the original 16-family panel. No new confirmation families, source-schema changes, or freshness claims.

replay_scope.selection_policy: Predetermined original exposed-development panel; independent of new confirmation candidates and outcomes. Do not validate/relabel unrelated historical confirmation-family entries through the whole old development manifest.

expected_protocol.formula: (14 UCI + 2 separately supplied legacy families) * 3 folds * 1 seed * 4 methods * 2 learners
expected_protocol.reference_policy: openfe-inductive is the existing width-matched reference with at most 50 native-ranked additions; not openfe-inductive-native.
expected_protocol.new_method_policy: featcopilot-frequency-paired is a pending implementation name and experiment descriptor only. This file does not implement, activate, validate or execute a new algorithm.
expected_protocol.runtime_binding: This descriptive development replay is not a confirmation preregistration or a new runtime configuration mechanism. Parent must pass and freeze the exact intended CLI/runtime settings before launch.

replay_scope.exposure_policy: Each full dataset entry is copied unchanged from the original expansion. Current registry normalization identifies all 14 as exposed development; no role, rights or exposure widening.
replay_scope.legacy_policy: Houses/wine remain separate cached legacy inputs under their existing protocol/rights labeling. They are not added to this catalog dataset list or newly admitted by this document.
replay_scope.reservation_policy: The ten active fresh-origin reservations are not included and are unchanged.
replay_scope.execution: No payload acquisition, model calls or performance inspection occurred while creating this replay descriptor.
